description: Policy for the flake gate, which reruns the unit suite and compares per-test outcomes. Findings live in flake-ratchet.json; this file holds only how the reruns are performed.
rationale: Three runs is the smallest number that can distinguish a flake from a fail: two runs disagreeing tells you something is unstable but not which outcome is the unusual one, and the suite takes about forty seconds, so three is two minutes. Raising it finds rarer flakes at linear cost — the nightly gate is the right place to spend that, and `--runs=` overrides it for a hunt.
shuffleRationale: Each nightly pass uses a deterministic adjacent seed. Different orders expose shared globals, ports, fake timers, and filesystem state; recording the seeds keeps every failure reproducible.
